# Share Your Feedback

We’d love to hear your thoughts. Fields marked with * are required.

<form id="feedbackForm">
  <label for="feedback">Feedback *</label><br>
  <textarea id="feedback" name="feedback" rows="5" required style="width:100%; max-width:800px;"></textarea><br><br>

  <label for="section">Page/Section (optional)</label><br>
  <input type="text" id="section" name="section"><br><br>

  <label for="email">Email (optional, if you’d like a reply)</label><br>
  <input type="email" id="email" name="email"><br><br>

  <button type="submit" class="toggle-all-button">Submit</button>
</form>


<div id="responseMessage" style="margin-top:1em; color: gray;">
  ⏳ No feedback submitted yet.
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const responseBox = document.getElementById("responseMessage");

  document.getElementById("feedbackForm").addEventListener("submit", async function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    // Show a "submitting..." state immediately
    responseBox.style.color = "gray";
    responseBox.innerText = "📤 Submitting your feedback...";

    const data = {
      feedback: document.getElementById("feedback").value,
      section: document.getElementById("section").value,
      email: document.getElementById("email").value
    };

    try {
      const response = await fetch("https://feedback.pixelprocess.org:8443/feedback", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        responseBox.style.color = "green";
        responseBox.innerText = "✅ Thank you! Your feedback was submitted.";
      } else {
        responseBox.style.color = "orange";
        responseBox.innerText = "⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again later.";
      }
    } catch (err) {
      responseBox.style.color = "red";
      responseBox.innerText = "⚠️ Error connecting to feedback server.";
    }
  });
});
</script>
